title: ggsegHO 2.1.0
text: FSL Harvard-Oxford atlases renamed snake_case, matching HOA-2 atlases rest ggsegverse: hoCort() now ho_cort() hoSub() now ho_sub(). old names still work return atlas, deprecation warning.

title: ggsegHO 2.1.0
text: ho2_sub() rebuilt grey-brain anatomical context, route ho_sub() takes: parcels embedded fsaverage5 aseg ggseg.extra::prepare_subcortical_mni152(), slice positions come subcortical_slabs() rather hard-coded, surrounding cortex white matter drawn grey context. Previously structures floated empty canvas across 12 cramped views. ho2_cereb() removed; four structures part ho2_sub(). HOA-2 divides cerebellum grey white matter , tissue segmentation like rest subcortical volume rather cerebellar parcellation sense SUIT Buckner. ho2_sub() therefore carries 23 structures across 4 views, including sagittal cut shows cerebellum along length. parcellated cerebellum, use ggsegCerebellum. cerebellar structures previously drew single undifferentiated mass carried doubled-labels (left_Cerebellar_Cortex_Left); now named , published HOA-2 lookup table. atlas keeps colours HOA-2 authors distribute, structure contralateral twin share colour. sagittal view now shows one hemisphere. previously spanned whole head, hemispheres flattened onto panel every left structure drawn underneath right twin — left caudate came 8% visible. Structures drawn symmetric order. geom_brain() paints rows order, pipeline’s order put Thalamus_Right last Thalamus_Left twelve rows earlier, right thalamus sat front ventral diencephalon left one behind . structure contralateral twin now adjacent, share depth. build scripts every atlas now data-raw/. HOA-2 scripts never committed, atlases reproduced repository.

title: ggsegHO 2.0.2
text: hoSub now renders grey-brain anatomical context. Harvard-Oxford subcortical structures registered fsaverage5 aseg surrounding cortex/white-matter/cerebellum/brainstem drawn grey context, coloured structures sit inside recognisable brain silhouette — matching FreeSurfer subcortical atlases. Regenerating requires FreeSurfer 7.4.1. Also swaps brittle hoSub-2d vdiffr snapshot structural assertions.

title: ggsegHO 2.0.1
